hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: First find the maximum element in each column of the matrix.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Create a copy of matrix where any cell with value -1 is replaced by its column maximum.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two-pass column maximum extraction and replacement.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-scanning the column for every -1 takes O(m^2 * n).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space for column maximums.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precompute column maximums in first pass before modifying matrix in second pass.
